content: Nutrament is a nutritional vitamin drink that was originally developed and distributed by Mead Johnson & Company starting in 1960. It is currently supplied by Novartis Labs. The drink is available in a variety of flavors, including vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, coconut, banana, cappuccino, and eggnog. It is packaged in individual pull-top cans for convenience. The product is officially described as a Nutritionally Complete Food, with its primary ingredients being milk solids, maltose-dextrins, soy flour, and sucrose. In the late 1960s, a powdered version of Nutrament was introduced, designed to be mixed with milk. However, the brand registration for this powdered form was not renewed in 1988, and it officially expired in 1992, though it remained under the ownership of Mead Johnson. In 1985, Mead Johnson also marketed a dietary supplement under the Nutrament brand. Later, in 1996, the company registered the brand Nutrament The Energy and Fitness Drink. On February 13, 2004, the Nutrament brand was officially acquired from Mead Johnson & Company.
